insights.summary: H1 FY26 revenue was ₹100 Cr with a ~21% EBITDA margin, a slow first half by the company's usual seasonality. Management expects H2 to beat H1, targets at least 35% revenue CAGR over five years, and says EBITDA margins should hold or edge up until FY27 and rise steeply from FY28 once the new Jarod plant makes resin-impregnated (RIP) bushing cores in-house and exports start. The plant should be ready by March 2026, with commercial production in H2 FY27. The Sukrut Electric acquisition was signed but not yet completed.

Equipment installation from January, trial production by Feb-Mar 2026, commercial production in H2 FY27.
Exports are 4.5-5% of revenue; RIP bushings can't be exported under the technology partner's restriction until the new plant makes its own cores.
